description.value: The Heriot Bay Inn is a historic island institution on Quadra Island, operating since 1896 with a pub, Herons Dining Room, ocean-view rooms and cabins, a full-service marina, and an RV park and campground. The HBI Pub is a year-round community gathering place featuring live music, weekly events, pub fare, and views over Heriot Bay. Touring cyclists will find a full-service stop with food, drink, and accommodation options in a remote but vibrant island community accessible by ferry from Campbell River.
